title: McGill 1988: csa anatomical of quadratus lumborum at L4-L5 (M, supine)

imaging.plane: single transverse slice with the gantry tilted to the plane of the L4/L5 disc

quantity.name: csa_anatomical
quantity.definition: anatomical cross-sectional area of the muscle in the image plane (as cut, not corrected for fibre direction)

source.authors: McGill SM, Patt N, Norman RW
source.sample: 13 active men; men referred for diagnostic CT (most with low back pain/sciatica), screened for activity level

how_to_simulate: Cut a plane through the L4/L5 disc centre parallel to the disc (gantry was tilted to the disc).
Sum the anatomical CSA of quadratus lumborum elements crossing the plane, each side (PCSA/cos(angle between fibre and plane normal)).
Compare right and left with mean +/- SD.

subject_model.source: Table 1 (SD age 11.9, height 5.9, weight 11.7); disc area 19.0 (2.4) cm2 Table 2

protocol.notes: Uncorrected (anatomic) area in the disc-parallel CT slice. cm2 -> mm2.

data.note: QL visible in only 1 (R) / 3 (L) subjects; SD printed "/"

extraction.check_notes: Average/SD rows compared with rendered Table 2 (p. 335); individual-subject rows not stored.
